evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: Pursuant to the Privacy Act of 1974, notice is hereby given that the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is modifying the system of records titled "Automated Safety Incident Surveillance and Tracking System (ASISTS)-VA" (99VA13). This system is used to identify specific cases of work-related injuries and illnesses, track and evaluate medical care of and services provided to injured or ill workers, and determine emerging causes, clusters of incidents, and outbreaks. A dated source update exists and should be compared with prior records. This record should be preserved, cross-referenced and upgraded only if stronger evidence changes the finding.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
